'''Double agents''' appear when doing [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] or [[Clue scroll (master)|master clue scroll]] emote clues. They call ''"I expect you to die!"'' upon appearing. They have a combat level of 108 for hard clues outside of the Wilderness and 65 within. They are level 141 for master clues.

After summoning the double agent, you may switch out of the equipment that the clue instructed, into equipment that is more suited for combat. If the double agent is killed while the player is wearing the equipment instructed to wear for the clue, [[Uri]] will immediately appear. Otherwise, the player must re-equip the items and perform the emote again.

For double agents fought in the Wilderness, players should avoid bringing items they are unwilling to lose. It is highly recommended that the corresponding [[STASH]] unit be built to store the item there rather than having to take it out from the bank.

==Trivia==
*Their appearance is identical to [[Uri]].
*The double agent will not appear during an emote clue if it is the first step in the Treasure Trail; the reasoning behind this is unknown.
*The phrase ''"I expect you to die!" ''is a reference to the 1964 film ''{{Wp|Goldfinger (film)|Goldfinger}}'' which was based on an {{Wp|Ian Fleming}} novel.
